h: Humility Before Hidden Wisdom Protects the Inner Sanctuary

p: because they cut down the thorns
which is the Field of Holy Apples.
And as it says in the holy Zohar
on this parshah, in the Idra:
"The companions gathered to the chamber of the Idra,
is the innermost part of the holy chamber,
and there protection from the outside forces is needed,
so that they not harm it,
sixty mighty men around it," etc.,
that on account of this allusion
there was placed in the Zohar
the holy Idra in Parshas Naso,
which is near the festival of Shavuos,
the time of the giving of our Torah,
"Draw me, we will run after You;
the King has brought me into His chambers."
For in their essence the souls of Yisrael
after Hashem, may He be blessed,
as was at the stand at Mount Sinai,
that they "were drawn to Your feet" (Devarim 33:3),
"and they stood at the bottom of the mountain" (Shemos 19:17);
that He draw her to Himself,
and then of itself "we will run after You,"
and "the King has brought me into His chambers."
And in the Midrash this pasuk is expounded
regarding the four who entered the Pardes,
and this was because of the thorns,
which have the ability even there
to mislead a person in subtle ways,
אֶת אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן גַּם בְּגַן עֵדֶן
Adam HaRishon even in Gan Eden.
that he imagined in his mind
"And I will surely hide My face":
is that there is hidden from a person
that nothing is hidden from his intellect.
And the main protection in this
is that he know in his soul
that He is the Hidden Intellect,
in matters in which you are a fool;
that they are beyond the grasp of your intellect,
and then "He will guard your foot from being caught."
And to this our Sages, of blessed memory, alluded
on the pasuk "Behold the couch of Shlomo,
because this is the main protection,
as it says in the holy Zohar on this parshah:
"At the time that they spread their hands
it is the time that there is revealed
and peace is found in all of them."
that he comes to know this in his soul,
that there is One higher than the high,
the Hidden Intellect beyond all thought;
and that is the revelation of Atika
and through this there is peace
when the head of Zeir Anpin is filled
through this one has the power
to be among the reapers of the field,
which is called "the voice of words,"
for the attribute of Malchus is called speech
and Shabbos, which is the attribute of Malchus,
of the reasons of the Torah,
that drips from the Holy Ancient One,
sweeter than honey to the soul.
